cleanupWarning: {summary}; some external data cleanup did not complete: {warning}

bulkQueuedForArchive: Added {count} tasks to the archive queue
tooManyForControl: You can control at most 100 tasks at a time
bulkResumedQueued: Resumed {count} tasks; some tasks were queued
tooManyForCategoryMove: You can change categories for at most 100 tasks at a time
bulkMoveFailedMore: {count} tasks could not be moved: {details}, etc.
noTasksYet: No tasks yet. Click “New task” in the top right to get started.
selectAllOnPage: Select all tasks on this page
sortToggle: {label} is currently {direction}; click to toggle sort direction
concurrencyEnabled: Concurrency limit enabled: up to {limit} tasks run at once
concurrencyLimitDescription: Limit how many tasks run at the same time. When the limit is reached, new tasks queue in creation order and start automatically when a slot frees up.
notControllable: This status cannot be paused or resumed
queuedMustPause: Queued tasks must be paused first
activeMustPause: Running or unfinished tasks must be paused first
archiveBlockedByInherit: This task directly inherits from unarchived task #{id}; archive the dependent task first
archiveConfirmDesc: Archiving stops task scheduling and compresses the graph, LLM history, files, and exclusive assets and traffic into local cold storage. Once archiving completes, you can restore the task from “Archived”.
archiveDeleteDesc: About {size} of archive packages and {rows} linked data snapshots will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
archivesLoadFailed: Failed to load the archive list: {message}
restoreQueued: Added {count} tasks to the restore queue
deleteQueued: Added {count} archives to the permanent deletion queue
noArchivesDesc: Paused or finished tasks can be archived from the current task list.
deleteAllDesc: Select all linked data below, including assets, traffic, files, findings, and LLM request/response records.
linkedAssetsDesc: Deletes assets that belong only to this task; shared assets are merely unlinked from this task.
linkedTrafficDesc: Deleted by the exact hostnames of linked assets; shared host traffic still referenced by other tasks is kept.
taskFilesDesc: Deletes uploaded files, command output, and other artifacts in this task’s working directory.
linkedFindingsDesc: Permanently deletes the standalone finding records and finding reports produced by this task.
llmRecordsDesc: Permanently deletes the LLM requests, responses, tokens, and error details recorded for this task.
deleteTaskSuffix: Its execution records and exploration chain will be permanently deleted.
changeCategoryDesc: The target category applies to all selected tasks; choosing “Uncategorized” removes them from their current category.
noCategoriesHint: No categories yet. Create one first in “Manage categories”.
bulkDeleteDesc: The execution records and exploration chains of these tasks will be permanently deleted. The cleanup options below apply to all selected tasks.
searchSourceTasks: Search task ID, description or goal
searchOrCreateCategory: Search categories, or type a new name and press Enter to create
typeToSearchCategory: Type a name to search or create a category
searchCompanies: Search company name or asset scope
categoryDeleted: Category deleted; linked tasks were moved to Uncategorized
targetCategoryMissing: The target category does not exist; please refresh and try again
categoryManageDesc: Categories are used for task filtering and archiving. Edits do not affect task execution; deleting a category moves its tasks to Uncategorized.
categoryInUse: {count} tasks currently use this category. Renaming will update the task list.
categoryAfterCreate: Once created, it can be used when creating tasks and filtering the task list.
emptyTasksHint: Content will appear here once tasks are assigned.
deleteCategoryDesc: After deletion, {count} tasks in it are automatically moved to “Uncategorized”; task data is not deleted.
fillDescGoal: Please fill in the description and goal
maxSourceTasks: Up to {max} source tasks can be linked
newTaskDesc: Fill in the test target and goal; expand advanced options as needed.
namePlaceholder: A recognizable name, e.g. Acme website pentest
categoryOptionalDesc: Optional, single category; used for task list filtering and archiving, and does not affect agent execution.
descriptionPlaceholder: Test target and background, e.g. test this example.com site
uploadedHint: {count} files uploaded; their absolute paths were appended to the end of the description (editable)
uploadHint: Multiple files allowed; after upload, their absolute paths are appended to the description so the worker can open them with Read/Bash
goalPlaceholderNew: What to achieve, e.g. gain admin panel access, obtain server access
linkedTasksDesc: Up to {max} tasks can be linked. Selected tasks’ persistent blackboards, asset scope and related traffic are inherited read-only in real time; the new task writes to its own blackboard.
companyScopeDesc: On creation, the selected companies’ existing assets are added to “Test assets”, and their domains, IPs, CIDRs, ICP filings and keywords are provided to the agent as scope context; intents are not generated automatically and the execution target is not changed.
interceptRulesDesc: Applies to this task only and is not written to global rules. Evaluation order: block rules (including global ones) match first and prohibit testing on a hit; if nothing matches and this task has allow rules, an asset must match an allow rule to be tested, otherwise it is also not tested; with no allow rules, no allowlist is enforced.
llmChainDesc: Failover follows the list order; the first item is the current profile, and the next one is used only when quota is clearly exhausted.
timeoutDesc: When the timeout is reached, a graceful wrap-up is triggered (agents write back and the planner makes a final judgment), and the task enters the timeout terminal state.
heartbeatDesc: If no trigger has fired for this duration since the last planning round ended or the task started, a planning round is triggered automatically (to recover from stalls and wake the workers being supervised). Minimum 10 minutes.
seedFirstIntent: Dispatch the first intent immediately (description + goal)
seedFirstIntentDesc: When enabled, the description and goal are dispatched as one intent at creation, so workers start right away without waiting for the first planning round; the planner then takes over to judge and supplement. Recommended for scenarios such as CTF where a single worker can solve the task; when disabled, the standard plan-then-execute flow is used.
coverageFeatureDesc: Enabled by default: computes and shows test coverage, displays test progress on the situation map, and accumulates the test scope automatically. When disabled, coverage is no longer computed or shown; the situation map only shows assets without progress, and agents no longer get scope tools. Disabling does not affect “Linked company asset scope”.
